items.title: 2 High-Flying Stocks to Own for Decades and 1 We Brush Off
items.summary: Expensive stocks typically earn their valuations through superior growth rates that other companies simply can’t match. The flip side though is that these lofty expectations make them particularly susceptible to drawdowns when market sentiment shifts.

items.title: The Biggest Risk Facing the First Trust Nasdaq Semiconductor ETF (FTXL) Right Now
items.summary: FTXL has handed holders a stunning run, but the modified-equal-weight label that made the fund feel safe may be hiding a concentration problem that turns one bad earnings call into a portfolio event.

items.title: Paul Tudor Jones Just Liquidated His Entire Stake in Applied Materials Stock. I Don’t Think He’s 100% Bearish on AI Though… Yet
items.summary: Paul Tudor Jones has a growing put position and a now-liquidated common stock position in Applied Materials. Is he bearish on AI?

items.title: Applied Materials Falls 4%, Lam Research and Teradyne Sink 5%: What’s Prompting the Selloff in Chip Equipment Stocks?
items.summary: Chip equipment stocks are selling off hard even as Treasury yields drop and the broader market climbs, and the disconnect points to something more troubling than a rates problem lurking beneath the AI infrastructure trade.

items.title: Is KLA (KLAC) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for KLA (KLAC) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

items.title: Applied Materials Rockets 98% in 2026: How Does AMAT Compare to Lam Research and KLA as AI Capex Powers Chip Gear Stocks?
items.summary: Chip equipment stocks have surged far ahead of the broader tech market in 2026, but a single week of doubts about AI spending just wiped billions in gains across the group. Here is what the gap between Applied Materials, Lam Research, and KLA signals about where the trade goes next.

items.title: Billionaire Joel Greenblatt’s 5 Biggest Moves This Quarter Reveal a Surprising Defensive Shift
items.summary: Joel Greenblatt built Gotham Asset Management on concentrated value bets, so his latest 13F filing caught analysts off guard with moves that look less like a stock-picker's conviction and more like someone quietly bracing for impact.
